header.title: The Mongol Empire
header.subtitle: Year by year, 1206 - 1294
header.hook: In seventy years, one steppe confederation built an empire from Korea to the Danube.
header.footnote: Borders approximate; raids not counted as territory.
header.outro: Within 75 years of Kublai's death, the Ilkhanate had collapsed and the Yuan had fallen.

territories.note: Western Xia destroyed; Chinggis Khan dies
Kose Dag: Seljuk Rum a vassal
Aleppo and Damascus taken: peak of the united empire

events.title: Chinggis Khan
events.text: Temüjin unites the steppe tribes and takes a new name.

events.title: Western Xia submits
events.text: The first settled kingdom to bow.

events.title: Zhongdu falls
events.text: The Jin capital, today's Beijing, is taken.

events.title: War on Khwarazm
events.text: After envoys are killed, Chinggis turns west.

events.title: Battle of the Indus
events.text: Khwarazm's last army is destroyed.

events.title: Chinggis Khan dies
events.text: His empire already stretches from the Caspian to the Yellow Sea.

events.title: Jin destroyed
events.text: Northern China falls after twenty years of war.

events.title: Kiev falls
events.text: The Rus' principalities submit.

events.title: Mohi
events.text: Hungary's army is destroyed. Europe is raided, not held.

events.title: Ögedei dies
events.text: The armies in Europe turn back.

events.title: Köse Dağ
events.text: The Seljuks of Anatolia become vassals.

events.title: Baghdad
events.text: Five centuries of Abbasid rule in Baghdad end.

events.title: Möngke dies
events.text: The last khan of a united empire.

events.title: Ain Jalut
events.text: The Mamluks defeat a Mongol army in Palestine.

events.title: Four khanates
events.text: After a civil war, the empire splits in four.

events.title: Yuan dynasty
events.text: Kublai Khan declares himself emperor of China.

events.title: Lin'an surrenders
events.text: The Song capital opens its gates.

events.title: Battle of Yamen
events.text: The last Song emperor dies. All China is under Mongol rule.

events.title: Kamikaze
events.text: A typhoon wrecks the second invasion fleet off Japan.

events.title: Kublai Khan dies
events.text: It remains the largest contiguous land empire in history.

youtube.title: The Mongol Empire, Year by Year (1206-1294)
youtube.summary: Every year of the Mongol Empire on one map: from Chinggis Khan's steppe confederation in 1206 to the largest contiguous land empire in history, its split into four khanates, and the death of Kublai Khan in 1294.
